answer: Violet Delta Mesh Agents must maintain connections to at least three other agents whose public keys form a triangle in the network graph. Each connection is validated via mutual signed attestations of reachability, forming a persistent delta in local topology. The signal is the density of such closed triplets within each agent’s neighborhood—only agents embedded in high-density clusters pass validation. An attacker must create multiple identities and forge enough false triangles to mimic this signal, requiring full mesh connectivity among their fake nodes.
